history.title: Quarterly report for the period ended June 30, 2026
history.summary: ARR up 31% year over year; net revenue retention 118%. No changes to risk factors.

NWSC.title: Item 2.02 and 7.01: Raised FY26 guidance; export licence pending
NWSC.summary: Northwind raises FY26 revenue guidance to 4.9bn from 4.6bn on accelerated 1.6T transceiver demand. Separately discloses that an export control licence for advanced optical modules to one jurisdiction remains pending.

NWSC.title: Item 5.02: Departure of Chief Financial Officer
NWSC.summary: The Chief Financial Officer will resign effective November 30, 2026 to pursue another opportunity. The company has begun a search; the VP Finance will serve as interim CFO.

LGS.title: Item 1.01: Multi-year utility contract
LGS.summary: Lumen Grid signs a five-year platform agreement with a top-ten US utility. Management reiterates full-year guidance.

HLXT.title: Item 8.01: FDA advisory committee update
HLXT.summary: FDA informed the company that the advisory committee for HX-201 is no longer planned; the PDUFA date of 14 November 2026 is unchanged. No new adverse event signals identified.
